tools.name: site_security_audit
tools.description: One-call website security audit with a 0-100 score, A-F grade and plain-English summary. Real, non-intrusive checks: TLS certificate (validity, expiry, issuer, protocol, hostname match), HTTP->HTTPS redirect, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), cookie flags, exposed sensitive files (/.git, /.env, config backups, phpinfo, server-status, directory listing), server/version disclosure, DNS (A/AAAA/MX/NS/CAA, DNSSEC), email spoofing protection (SPF, DMARC policy, common DKIM selectors) and CMS/version detection. Every finding has a severity and a fix. ~20 s max, light GET requests only. Returns JSON with: domain, score, grade, summary, counts, findings, tls, http. Price: $0.05 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/site-security-audit

domain.description: Domain or URL of the public website to audit, e.g. example.com

tools.name: solana_token_safety

Pre-buy safety check for any Solana token (SPL or Token-2022) with a 0-100 risk score, flags and plain-English verdict. Live on-chain + public data: mint and freeze authority, supply/decimals, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, non-transferable, default-frozen, pausable), top-10 holder concentration (pools excluded), DEX liquidity/pools and LP lock (DexScreener, RugCheck), a real Jupiter sell-route quote (basic honeypot test), token age and RugCheck risks. Returns JSON with: mint, symbol, riskScore, riskLevel, verdict, flags, token, holders. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/solana-token-safety

tools.name: isin_validate

tools.name: cusip_validate
tools.description: CUSIP check digit. Nine characters from digits, letters, and * @ #. Spaces are ignored and hyphens are not. tools.name: figi_validate

tools.description: Apply a chmod mode to a starting mode. The grammar is GNU chmod: symbolic [ugoa]*([-+=][rwxXst]* or one of ugo), comma separated, or =644 / +1, or a bare octal. No spaces. If who is omitted, bits set in umask are not changed; the default umask is 0. Explicit who ignores umask. X adds execute only on a directory, or when an execute bit is already set. On a directory, bare octal shorter than five digits keeps set-user-ID and set-group-ID; =755, 00755, or a symbolic s clears them. The sticky bit is not kept across = or bare octal. Returns JSON with: value, octal, octal4, symbolic, setuid, setgid, sticky, owner. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/chmod-apply

tools.name: umask_mode
tools.description: Mode of a file or directory created under a umask. A file starts from 666 and a directory from 777, then the umask bits are cleared. 022 makes a file 644 and a directory 755. masked lists the bits the umask turns off. Returns JSON with: value, octal, octal4, symbolic, setuid, setgid, sticky, owner. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/umask-mode

tools.name: permission_check
tools.description: Whether one class may read, write, or execute under a mode. Pass the class that applies: on a real system the owner class is used for the owner even when the group bits differ. setuid, setgid and sticky do not grant the bit. Returns JSON with: value, octal, octal4, symbolic, setuid, setgid, sticky, owner. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/permission-check

tools.name: mode_diff
tools.description: Bits that differ between two POSIX modes. added and removed run from the special bits down through owner, group and other. same is true when nothing differs. Returns JSON with: from, to, added, removed, same. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mode-diff

tools.name: float_bits
tools.description: Explain an IEEE 754 binary32 or binary64 value. Pass bits as hex, or a decimal or fraction, which is rounded ties-to-even. Returns the class, sign, unbiased exponent, fraction bits, and the exact value. Negative zero stays negative. The word nan is the quiet NaN; snan is the signaling NaN with payload 1. The top fraction bit is the quiet bit. Returns JSON with: width, bits, kind, sign, exponent, hidden, significand, quiet. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-bits

tools.name: float_round
tools.description: Round an exact decimal or fraction to binary32 or binary64. Modes are nearestEven, towardZero, towardPositive, and towardNegative. Ties in nearestEven go to an even fraction bit. Overflow becomes infinity, or the largest finite value when the mode points toward zero. underflow is set only when the result is subnormal or zero and not exact. Returns JSON with: width, bits, kind, sign, exponent, hidden, significand, quiet. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-round

tools.name: float_next
tools.description: The next binary32 or binary64 value up or down. Positive zero and negative zero both step up to the smallest positive subnormal, and both step down to the smallest negative one. Infinity stays put at its end. A NaN is returned with its payload unchanged. Returns JSON with: width, bits, kind, sign, exponent, hidden, significand, quiet. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-next

tools.name: float_ulp
tools.description: Unit in the last place of a binary32 or binary64 value. A power of two uses the spacing of its own binade. Zero uses the smallest subnormal. Infinity uses positive infinity. A NaN is returned with its payload unchanged. Returns JSON with: width, bits, kind, sign, exponent, hidden, significand, quiet. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-ulp

tools.name: float_order
tools.description: IEEE 754 totalOrder on two binary32 or binary64 values. Negative zero is below positive zero. Negative NaNs are below minus infinity and positive NaNs are above plus infinity. A larger NaN payload is farther from zero. sameBits is true only when every bit matches. form bits reads both sides as hex; the default reads them as numbers rounded ties-to-even. Returns JSON with: width, form, cmp, sameBits, left, right, leftKind, rightKind. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-order

tools.name: midi_note
tools.description: A written note or a MIDI number. Middle C is C4, which is 60. C-1 is 0 and G9 is 127. The name you pass keeps its spelling, so B#3 stays B#3 even though it is the same key as C4. sharp and flat are the two usual names of that key. x is a double sharp. Returns JSON with: name, midi, letter, accidental, octave, pc, sharp, flat. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/midi-note

tools.name: music_interval
tools.description: The interval between two written notes. The number comes from the letters and the quality from the semitones, so C to E is a major third and C to Fb is a diminished fourth. Direction follows the written notes. Semitones is negative when the second note is lower. Returns JSON with: from, to, direction, semitones, distance, number, simple, compound. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-interval

tools.name: music_transpose
tools.description: Move a written note by a named interval. The letter moves with the interval number, then the accidental is chosen to hit the semitones. A perfect third is rejected, and so is a quality that would need more than a double accidental. Up and down are the two directions. Returns JSON with: name, midi, letter, accidental, octave, pc, dir, quality. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-transpose

tools.name: music_scale
tools.description: Spell a scale on letters from a tonic. Major, minor, harmonic minor, melodic minor (the ascending form), the church modes, pentatonic, minor pentatonic, and blues. G# major is written with E# and F##, not with flats. signature lists the accidentals in scale order. The octave does not repeat the tonic. Returns JSON with: tonic, mode, spelling, signature, notes, count. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-scale

tools.name: music_chord
tools.description: Spell a chord up from a root: major, minor, diminished, augmented, sus2, sus4, dom7, maj7, min7, dim7, half-dim7, and sixth. Letters stay in thirds except the suspensions and the sixth. A diminished seventh uses a double flat when the spelling needs it. Returns JSON with: root, quality, spelling, notes, count. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/music-chord

tools.name: paper_size
tools.description: ISO 216 A, B and C sizes, plus the DL envelope, in millimeters. Portrait, so the width is the shorter side. Inches are exact millimeters divided by 25.4. A4 is 210 by 297. Set landscape to swap the sides. Returns JSON with: name, series, number, widthMm, heightMm, areaMm2, widthIn, heightIn. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/paper-size

tools.name: paper_next
tools.description: The next larger and smaller sheet in the same ISO series. A4 sits between A3 and A5. A0 has no larger size and A10 has no smaller one. DL is not in a series. Returns JSON with: name, larger, smaller. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/paper-next

tools.name: paper_fit
tools.description: How many copies of one sheet fit on another at full size. The copy may be turned. Two A4 pages fill an A3 and the waste is zero. count is 0 when it does not fit. orientation is how the copy sits, or none. Returns JSON with: outer, inner, count, orientation, wasteMm2. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/paper-fit

tools.name: paper_scale
tools.description: The largest scale that places one sheet on another, turning it when that lets it be larger. The scale is an exact ratio of the millimeter sides. Below one, the sheet has to shrink. Returns JSON with: sheet, onto, scale, decimal, rotated. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/paper-scale

tools.name: envelope_fit
tools.description: The smallest ISO C envelope that holds a sheet flat, and whether a DL envelope holds it flat or folded in exact thirds. C4 holds A4. DL does not hold A4 flat; it holds A4 folded in thirds. A sheet bigger than C0 has no C envelope. Returns JSON with: name, flat, dlFlat, dlThird. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/envelope-fit

tools.name: timecode_frames
tools.description: Count the frames in an SMPTE timecode from midnight. Rates are 24, 25 and 30. A colon is non-drop and a semicolon is drop-frame, which is only legal at 30. Drop-frame skips 00 and 01 at the start of each minute except every tenth minute, so 01:00:00;00 is frame 107892 rather than 108000. Returns JSON with: hours, minutes, seconds, frame, drop, rate, frames, code. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/timecode-frames

tools.name: frames_timecode
tools.description: Write a frame count since midnight as SMPTE timecode. Set drop for 30 fps drop-frame. The count has to land inside one day. 30 frames at 30 fps is 00:00:01:00. Returns JSON with: hours, minutes, seconds, frame, drop, rate, frames, code. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/frames-timecode

tools.name: timecode_add
tools.description: Add a signed frame count to a timecode and stay inside the same day. A result before midnight or at the next midnight is rejected. The semicolon, if present, keeps the result in drop-frame. Returns JSON with: hours, minutes, seconds, frame, drop, rate, frames, code. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/timecode-add

tools.name: timecode_diff
tools.description: How many frames from one timecode to another, at the same rate. Positive means to is later. Both codes use a colon, or both use a semicolon. Mixing drop-frame with non-drop is rejected. Returns JSON with: from, to, rate, drop, frames. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/timecode-diff

tools.name: timecode_duration
tools.description: Exact length of a frame count. 24, 25 and non-drop 30 use 1/rate second per frame. Drop-frame 30 uses the NTSC frame, 1001/30000 second. Pass a timecode or a frame count, not both. The semicolon selects drop-frame when you pass a code. Returns JSON with: seconds, decimal, frames, rate, drop, code. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/timecode-duration

tools.name: crc16
tools.description: CRC-16 over text or hex bytes. Algorithms are CCITT-FALSE, ARC, XMODEM, KERMIT and MODBUS. The check string 123456789 is 29b1 in CCITT-FALSE. This is not CRC-32. Returns JSON with: algorithm, value, hex. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/crc16

tools.name: fletcher16
tools.description: Fletcher-16 checksum, modulus 255. The two sums are packed with the second sum in the high byte. "abcde" is c8f0. Returns JSON with: algorithm, value, hex. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fletcher16

tools.name: fletcher32
tools.description: Fletcher-32 checksum, modulus 65535. Bytes are big-endian 16-bit words. An odd final byte is padded with zero. "abcde" is 4ff029c7. Returns JSON with: algorithm, value, hex. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fletcher32

tools.name: inet_checksum
tools.description: RFC 1071 internet checksum. Big-endian 16-bit words are added with end-around carry, then inverted. An odd final byte is padded with zero. The RFC example 0001 F203 F4F5 F6F7 is 220d. Returns JSON with: algorithm, value, hex. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/inet-checksum

tools.name: byte_sum
tools.description: The two historic Unix sums, matching GNU sum. bsd rotates the 16-bit sum right and counts 1024-byte blocks. sysv reduces modulo 65535, keeps 65535 when the total is a positive multiple of it, and counts 512-byte blocks. "123456789" is bsd 53615 and sysv 477. Returns JSON with: algorithm, value, hex, blocks, bytes. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/byte-sum

tools.name: cf_expand
tools.description: Continued fraction of a non-negative rational, by the Euclidean algorithm. 13/8 is [1; 1, 1, 1, 2]. 355/113 is [3; 7, 16]. A trailing 1 is folded into the previous term, so this is the short form. Returns JSON with: terms, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-expand

tools.name: cf_value
tools.description: Exact value of a continued fraction [a0; a1, a2, ...]. Later terms are at least 1. [3; 7, 15, 1] and [3; 7, 16] are both 355/113. The canonical field is the short Euclidean form. Returns JSON with: fraction, numerator, denominator, decimal, terms, canonical. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-value

tools.name: cf_convergent
tools.description: One convergent of a continued fraction. Index 0 is a0/1. The last index is the value itself. 13/8 at index 3 is 5/3. Returns JSON with: fraction, numerator, denominator, decimal, index. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-convergent

tools.name: cf_best
tools.description: Best rational approximation with a denominator up to maxDen. It searches the convergents and the intermediate fractions. 355/113 with maxDen 7 is 22/7. With maxDen 100 it is 311/99. Returns JSON with: fraction, numerator, denominator, decimal, maxDen, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-best

tools.name: cf_sqrt
tools.description: Continued fraction of a square root. sqrt(2) is [1; 2, 2, 2, ...] and the period is 1. sqrt(3) has period 2. A perfect square is one term and period 0. The period is the repeating length, even when fewer terms are requested. Returns JSON with: s, square, period, terms, count. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-sqrt

tools.name: morse_encode
tools.description: Encode text as international Morse (ITU-R M.1677). Letters are separated by one space and words by " / ". SOS is ... --- ... Digits and the recommendation punctuation are included. Other characters are rejected. Returns JSON with: code, text. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/morse-encode

tools.name: morse_decode
tools.description: Decode international Morse. Letters are separated by one space and words by " / ". The result is capitals. ... --- ... is SOS. Returns JSON with: text, code. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/morse-decode

tools.name: morse_timing
tools.description: How long a Morse message takes at a given speed. The dit is 1200/wpm milliseconds. PARIS is 43 units, or 50 units once the trailing 7-unit word gap of a stream is added. SOS is 27 units. Returns JSON with: code, wpm, units, streamUnits, dit, dah, milliseconds, decimal. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/morse-timing

tools.name: bezier_cubic
tools.description: Point on a cubic Bezier at t, as an exact fraction. t is between 0 and 1. The arch (0,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1,0) at one half is (1/2, 3/4). Returns JSON with: point, t. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bezier-cubic

tools.name: bezier_quadratic
tools.description: Point on a quadratic Bezier at t, as an exact fraction. (0,0), (1,1), (2,0) at one half is (1, 1/2). Returns JSON with: point, t. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bezier-quadratic

tools.name: bezier_split
tools.description: Split a quadratic or cubic Bezier at t by de Casteljau. Left and right are the two new control polygons, and they meet at the point on the curve. Returns JSON with: t, point, left, right. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bezier-split

tools.name: bezier_derivative
tools.description: Control points of the derivative of a quadratic or cubic Bezier. A cubic derivative is a quadratic, and each control is the degree times the step to the next point. Returns JSON with: degree, points. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bezier-derivative

tools.name: bezier_tangent
tools.description: Tangent vector of a quadratic or cubic Bezier at t. It is the derivative curve evaluated at t. The arch (0,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1,0) at one half has tangent (3/2, 0). Returns JSON with: t, x, y. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bezier-tangent

tools.name: quat_mul
tools.description: Hamilton product of two quaternions, scalar first. i times j is k, and j times i is minus k. Components are exact fractions. Returns JSON with: w, x, y, z. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/quat-mul

tools.name: quat_norm
tools.description: Conjugate and squared length of a quaternion. (1, 2, 3, 4) has squared length 30 and conjugate (1, -2, -3, -4). Unit means the squared length is 1. Returns JSON with: w, x, y, z, norm2, unit. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/quat-norm

tools.name: quat_inv
tools.description: Inverse of a quaternion, the conjugate divided by the squared length. (1, 2, 3, 4) inverts to (1/30, -1/15, -1/10, -2/15). Zero has no inverse. Returns JSON with: w, x, y, z. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/quat-inv

tools.name: quat_rotate
tools.description: Rotate a vector by a quaternion, q v q inverse. k sends (1, 0, 0) to (-1, 0, 0), a half turn about z. Scaling q does not change the turn. Returns JSON with: w, x, y, z. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/quat-rotate

tools.name: quat_pow
tools.description: Integer power of a quaternion. i squared is -1, and i to the fourth is 1. Exponent 0 is 1, including zero to the 0. A negative power inverts first. Returns JSON with: w, x, y, z, exp. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/quat-pow

tools.name: perm_sign
tools.description: Sign of a permutation of 0..n-1, from the number of inversions. [2, 1, 0] has three inversions and sign -1. The identity has sign 1. Returns JSON with: inversions, sign, n, perm. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perm-sign

tools.name: perm_inverse
tools.description: Inverse of a permutation of 0..n-1. The inverse of [1, 2, 0] is [2, 0, 1]. Applying both is the identity. Returns JSON with: perm, n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perm-inverse

tools.name: perm_compose
tools.description: Compose two permutations of the same length. a is applied first, then b, so the result at i is b[a[i]]. Both must use 0..n-1 once each. Returns JSON with: perm, n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perm-compose

tools.name: perm_next
tools.description: The next permutation in lexicographic order. After [0, 1, 2] comes [0, 2, 1]. The reverse, [2, 1, 0], is the last and has no successor. Returns JSON with: perm, n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perm-next

tools.name: perm_rank
tools.description: Lexicographic rank of a permutation, or the permutation at a rank. [0, 1, 2] is rank 0 and [2, 0, 1] is rank 4. Give the permutation, or n and a rank, not both. n is at most 10. Returns JSON with: perm, n, rank. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perm-rank

tools.name: pell
tools.description: The nth Pell number. P0 is 0, P1 is 1, and each later term is twice the previous one plus the one before that. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pell

tools.name: pell_lucas
tools.description: The nth companion Pell-Lucas number. Q0 and Q1 are both 2, and later terms use the Pell recurrence. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pell-lucas

tools.name: pell_equation
tools.description: The nth solution of the Pell equation x^2 - 2y^2 = (-1)^n. x is half the companion Pell-Lucas number and y is the Pell number. A supplied norm must equal that sign. n runs from 0 to 8192. Returns JSON with: n, x, y, norm. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pell-equation

tools.name: pell_sum
tools.description: The sum of Pell numbers, or companion Pell-Lucas numbers, from lo through hi inclusive. seq is p or q. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 8192. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, seq, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pell-sum

tools.name: pell_compose
tools.description: Compose two solutions of x^2 - 2y^2 = ±1. The unit for index a multiplied by the unit for index b is the unit for a+b. a+b must be at most 8192. Returns JSON with: a, b, n, x, y, norm. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pell-compose

tools.name: binom
tools.description: The binomial coefficient C(n, k). k must not exceed n, and both indexes run up to 4096. An optional modulus reduces the coefficient; zero is rejected. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/binom

tools.name: catalan
tools.description: The nth Catalan number. C0 and C1 are 1, C2 is 2, C3 is 5, and C_n = binom(2n, n) / (n+1). n runs from 0 to 2048. An optional modulus reduces the term; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/catalan

tools.name: ballot
tools.description: The ballot number B(n, k) = (n-k+1)/(n+1) * binom(n+k, k), for 0 <= k <= n. B(n, n) is the nth Catalan number. k above n is rejected. Both indexes run up to 2048. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ballot

tools.name: dyck_word
tools.description: Check a Dyck word of parentheses and report its semilength and height. The empty word is valid. A prefix that goes negative, or a word that does not close, is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, height. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/dyck-word

tools.name: motzkin
tools.description: The nth Motzkin number. M0 and M1 are 1, M2 is 2, M4 is 9, from M_n = sum binom(n, 2k) C_k. n runs from 0 to 512. An optional modulus reduces the term; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/motzkin

tools.name: mod_pow
tools.description: base^exp mod m, exact, for a non-negative exponent. The modulus must be at least 1. A negative exponent is rejected. Decimals have no leading zeros and at most 200 digits. Returns JSON with: value, mod. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mod-pow

tools.name: mod_inv
tools.description: The modular inverse of a modulo m, as a residue from 0 up to m-1. The modulus must be at least 1. A value that is not coprime to m is rejected. Returns JSON with: value, mod. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mod-inv

tools.name: crt
tools.description: Solve simultaneous congruences x ≡ a_i (mod m_i). Shared factors are allowed when the system is consistent; an inconsistent system is rejected. The result is the smallest non-negative solution and the lcm of the moduli. Returns JSON with: x, modulus. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/crt

tools.name: jacobi
tools.description: The Jacobi symbol (a/n). n must be odd and positive. The value is -1, 0, or 1. An even or non-positive n is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobi

tools.name: egcd
tools.description: Extended gcd of a and b. Returns g, x, and y with g = a*x + b*y and g >= 0. gcd(0, 0) is rejected. Decimals have no leading zeros. Returns JSON with: g, x, y. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/egcd

tools.name: pythag_gen
tools.description: The Pythagorean triple from m > n >= 1 and scale k >= 1. a is k(m^2-n^2), b is k(2mn), and c is k(m^2+n^2). primitive is true when k is 1, m and n are coprime, and they have opposite parity. Returns JSON with: a, b, c, primitive. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pythag-gen

tools.name: pythag_check
tools.description: Check a^2 + b^2 = c^2 for positive integers, with c the hypotenuse. primitive is true when the three sides are coprime. A side triple that fails the equation is rejected. Returns JSON with: a, b, c, primitive. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pythag-check

tools.name: heron_area
tools.description: Exact area data for a strict integer triangle. sixteen is 16 times the squared area. When sixteen is a perfect square, area is the reduced value of its square root over 4. A degenerate triple is rejected. Returns JSON with: sixteen, area. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/heron-area

tools.name: cosine_law
tools.description: The cosine of the angle opposite side c, as a reduced rational (a^2+b^2-c^2)/(2ab). The sides must form a strict triangle. A right angle returns 0. Returns JSON with: cos. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cosine-law

tools.name: triangle_shape
tools.description: Classify a strict integer triangle. sides is equilateral, isosceles, or scalene. angles is acute, right, or obtuse, from comparing the squares of the sides. A degenerate triple is rejected. Returns JSON with: sides, angles. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/triangle-shape

tools.name: stern
tools.description: Stern's diatomic sequence. s(0) is 0, s(1) is 1, even terms repeat s(n/2), and an odd term is the sum of its two neighbors in the previous row. An optional modulus reduces the term; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stern

tools.name: calkin_wilf
tools.description: The Calkin-Wilf tree. Give n to get the nth positive rational, starting at 1/1, or give a reduced num and den to get its index. The two answers must agree when both are sent. An unreduced fraction is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/calkin-wilf

tools.name: mediant
tools.description: The mediant of a/b and c/d, which is (a+c)/(b+d) reduced by their gcd. Numerators may be zero. A non-positive denominator is rejected. Returns JSON with: num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mediant

tools.name: farey_adjacent
tools.description: Whether a/b and c/d are Farey neighbors. They are adjacent when the determinant ad-bc is 1 or -1. A non-positive denominator is rejected. Returns JSON with: adjacent, det. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/farey-adjacent

tools.name: farey_child
tools.description: The mediant child of a Farey-neighbor pair. a/b and c/d must satisfy |ad-bc| = 1. A pair that is not adjacent is rejected, as is a non-positive denominator. Returns JSON with: num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/farey-child

tools.name: partition
tools.description: The number of integer partitions p(n), from the pentagonal recurrence. p(0) is 1, p(5) is 7, and p(10) is 42. n runs from 0 to 2000. An optional modulus reduces the count; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/partition

tools.name: partition_distinct
tools.description: The number of partitions of n into distinct positive parts. This equals the number of partitions into odd parts. q(0) is 1 and q(5) is 3. n runs from 0 to 2000. An optional modulus reduces the count; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/partition-distinct

tools.name: pentagonal
tools.description: The generalized pentagonal number n(3n-1)/2. n may be negative. n = 1 gives 1, n = -1 gives 2, and n = 0 is rejected. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pentagonal

tools.name: partition_conjugate
tools.description: The conjugate of an integer partition, read down the columns of its Ferrers diagram. Parts must be positive and nonincreasing. The empty partition is its own conjugate. Returns JSON with: parts, sum, length. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/partition-conjugate

tools.name: partition_parts
tools.description: Check an integer partition and return its sum and length. Parts must be positive and nonincreasing. The empty list is the partition of zero. A rise or a zero part is rejected. Returns JSON with: parts, sum, length. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/partition-parts

tools.name: base_convert
tools.description: Convert an integer from one base to another. Bases run from 2 to 36, and letters may be any case. A digit that is not valid in the source base is rejected. The result is the digit string in the target base. Returns JSON with: value, from, to. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/base-convert

tools.name: digit_sum
tools.description: The sum of the decimal digits of an integer, ignoring the sign. 199 sums to 19. The decimal has no leading zeros. A malformed integer is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/digit-sum

tools.name: digital_root
tools.description: The digital root of a decimal integer. Zero stays zero, and any other magnitude is 1 + (n-1) mod 9, so multiples of 9 have root 9. The sign is ignored. A malformed integer is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/digital-root

tools.name: digit_rev
tools.description: Reverse the decimal digits of an integer. Leading zeros of the reversal are dropped, so 1200 becomes 21. The sign is kept. A malformed integer is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/digit-rev

tools.name: repunit
tools.description: The repunit of length n, (10^n - 1)/9. R1 is 1 and R2 is 11. n = 0 is rejected. n runs up to 500. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/repunit

tools.name: gray_encode
tools.description: Encode a non-negative integer as a binary reflected Gray code. The code is n xor (n shifted right by one). Zero stays zero, and a negative integer is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gray-encode

tools.name: gray_decode
tools.description: Decode a binary reflected Gray code back to its index. The walk xors the code with each of its right shifts. A negative code is rejected. Returns JSON with: g, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gray-decode

tools.name: gray_next
tools.description: The next binary reflected Gray code after g. It is the code of the index one past the index of g. A negative code is rejected. Returns JSON with: g, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gray-next

tools.name: gray_flip
tools.description: The single bit that flips in the binary reflected Gray code when the index goes from n to n+1. Bit 0 is the least significant bit. A negative index is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, bit. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gray-flip

tools.name: gray_bits
tools.description: The binary reflected Gray code of n, written in exactly width bits. Bit 0 is on the right. n must be smaller than 2^width. A width that cannot hold n is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, width, bits. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gray-bits

tools.name: poly_add
tools.description: Add two integer polynomials, lowest degree first. Trailing zeros are dropped, and the zero polynomial is an empty list. An optional modulus reduces each coefficient; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/poly-add

tools.name: poly_mul
tools.description: Multiply two integer polynomials, lowest degree first. The zero polynomial is an empty list. An optional modulus reduces each coefficient; zero is rejected. A coefficient past 15 digits is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/poly-mul

tools.name: poly_eval
tools.description: Evaluate an integer polynomial at an integer point, by Horner. The zero polynomial evaluates to 0. An optional modulus reduces the result; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/poly-eval

tools.name: poly_deriv
tools.description: Differentiate an integer polynomial. The derivative of a constant is the zero polynomial, which is an empty list. An optional modulus reduces each coefficient; zero is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/poly-deriv

tools.name: poly_div
tools.description: Exact quotient of two integer polynomials. The divisor must be non-zero, and every leading step must divide in the integers. A zero divisor or a non-integral quotient is rejected. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/poly-div

tools.name: totient
tools.description: Euler totient phi(n), the count of integers from 1 to n that are coprime to n. phi(1) is 1. n = 0 is rejected. n runs up to 10^12. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/totient

tools.name: mobius
tools.description: The Mobius function mu(n). It is 0 when n has a squared prime factor, and otherwise (-1)^k for k distinct primes. mu(1) is 1. n = 0 is rejected. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mobius

tools.name: divisor_count
tools.description: The number of positive divisors of n. A prime has 2, and d(1) is 1. n = 0 is rejected. n runs up to 10^12. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/divisor-count

tools.name: divisor_sum
tools.description: The sum of the positive divisors of n. sigma(6) is 12 and sigma(28) is 56. n = 0 is rejected. A value past 15 digits is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/divisor-sum

tools.name: prime_check
tools.description: Whether n is prime, by trial division. 1 is not prime. n < 1 is rejected. n runs up to 10^12. Returns JSON with: n, prime. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-check

tools.name: egypt_greedy
tools.description: The greedy Egyptian fraction for a proper positive fraction a/b. 5/6 is 1/2 + 1/3. A fraction that is not strictly between 0 and 1 is rejected. Returns JSON with: dens. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/egypt-greedy

tools.name: unit_sum
tools.description: The reduced sum of unit fractions 1/d. Dens must be positive. An empty list or a non-positive denominator is rejected. Returns JSON with: num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/unit-sum

tools.name: harmonic
tools.description: The nth harmonic number as a reduced fraction. H1 is 1/1, H2 is 3/2, and H6 is 49/20. n < 1 is rejected. n runs up to 200. Returns JSON with: n, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/harmonic

tools.name: sylvester
tools.description: The nth Sylvester number. s(0) is 2, and each later term is s*(s-1)+1. A negative index is rejected. n runs up to 8. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sylvester

tools.name: egypt_check
tools.description: Check that a sum of unit fractions equals the fraction a/b. A match returns the reduced sum. A sum that differs, or a non-positive denominator, is rejected. Returns JSON with: num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/egypt-check

tools.name: jacobsthal
tools.description: The nth Jacobsthal number. J0 is 0, J1 is 1, and each later term is the previous one plus twice the one before that. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobsthal

tools.name: jacobsthal_lucas
tools.description: The nth Jacobsthal-Lucas number. L0 is 2, L1 is 1, and later terms use the Jacobsthal recurrence. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobsthal-lucas

tools.name: jacobsthal_sum
tools.description: The sum of Jacobsthal numbers, or Jacobsthal-Lucas numbers, from lo through hi inclusive. seq is j or l. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 8192. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, seq, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobsthal-sum

tools.name: jacobsthal_add
tools.description: The Jacobsthal addition rule. (L(a)*J(b) + J(a)*L(b)) / 2 is J(a+b). a+b must be at most 8192. Returns JSON with: a, b, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobsthal-add

tools.name: jacobsthal_power
tools.description: The power identity J(n) + J(n+1) = 2^n. left is J(n), right is J(n+1), and value is their sum. n runs from 0 to 8191 so that n+1 stays in range. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, left, right, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobsthal-power

tools.name: padovan
tools.description: The nth Padovan number. P0, P1, and P2 are 1, and each later term is the sum of the term two back and the term three back. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/padovan

tools.name: perrin
tools.description: The nth Perrin number. R0 is 3, R1 is 0, R2 is 2, and later terms use the Padovan recurrence. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perrin

tools.name: padovan_sum
tools.description: The sum of Padovan numbers, or Perrin numbers, from lo through hi inclusive. seq is p or r. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 8192. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, seq, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/padovan-sum

tools.name: perrin_divide
tools.description: The remainder of the nth Perrin number divided by n. A prime n divides R(n), so the remainder is 0. n runs from 1 to 8192. Past 15 digits the Perrin number is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value, rem, divides. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perrin-divide

tools.name: padovan_step
tools.description: The Padovan step identity P(n) = P(n-1) + P(n-5). left is P(n-1) and right is P(n-5). n runs from 5 to 8192. Past 15 digits a term is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, left, right, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/padovan-step

tools.name: stirling2
tools.description: The Stirling number of the second kind S(n,k), the number of ways to partition n objects into k nonempty unlabeled sets. S(5,2) is 15. S(n,k) is 0 when k is greater than n. n and k run from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling2

tools.name: bell
tools.description: The nth Bell number, the number of partitions of a set of n objects. B(0) and B(1) are 1, and B(5) is 52. n runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bell

tools.name: stirling2_row
tools.description: Row n of Stirling numbers of the second kind, from S(n,0) through S(n,n), plus the Bell number that sums the row. n runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits an entry is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, row, bell. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling2-row

tools.name: bell_sum
tools.description: The sum of Bell numbers from lo through hi inclusive. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the sum is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bell-sum

tools.name: stirling2_rec
tools.description: The Stirling recurrence S(n,k) = k*S(n-1,k) + S(n-1,k-1). term is the first summand and diag is the second. n and k run from 1 to 80. Past 15 digits a part is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, term, diag, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling2-rec

tools.name: delannoy
tools.description: The Delannoy number D(m,n), the number of paths from (0,0) to (m,n) using steps (1,0), (0,1), and (1,1). D(3,5) is 231. m and n run from 0 to 64. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: m, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/delannoy

tools.name: delannoy_central
tools.description: The central Delannoy number D(n,n). D(0,0) is 1 and D(3,3) is 63. n runs from 0 to 64. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/delannoy-central

tools.name: schroder
tools.description: The nth large Schröder number. S(0) is 1, S(1) is 2, and S(5) is 394. n runs from 0 to 64. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/schroder

tools.name: schroder_little
tools.description: The nth little Schröder number. It is 1 at n = 0 and half the large Schröder number for n > 0. s(5) is 197. n runs from 0 to 64. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/schroder-little
